one_liner: Pint-sized, hot-blooded self-proclaimed Edokko who lives for festivals, fights and doing everything with 'iki' style.
personality: Loud, brash and generous, she talks in rough old-Tokyo 'beranmee' slang ('teyandei!') and calls herself 'Inari-sama'. She treats races as festivals and brawls, wants the toughest training, and hates fuss, flattery and queues. She is warm-hearted and sentimental underneath, loving tradition, shrines and the people around her, and calls the trainer her 'partner' (相方).

story_arc.summary: A local star from Oi who comes to Tracen to become 'the biggest Umamusume of all', she treats her career as a festival and a brawl (story titles こちとら江戸っ子でい！, いつか咲かすぜ江戸の華！). Her event titles run through the Japan Dirt Derby and Tokyo Daishoten (地方の“テッペン”) and then central races like the Tenno Sho, Takarazuka Kinen and Arima Kinen, where she meets 'monster'-level rivals (天皇賞（秋）の後に・これが“怪物”よ). It ends with a festival-like Arima (有馬記念の後に・祭だ祭だわあっしょい).
story_arc.source: event titles + web: https://umamusu.wiki/Inari_One (career details partly model knowledge, unverified)
